title: Credentials
intro: TranquilHaven Coaching is grounded in formal coach training and extensive education in psychology and relational systems.
items: Completed an ICF-accredited Level 2 coach training program (CoachingUp University)
Advanced coach training focused on communication, relationship skills, and personal development
Psychology-informed coach with advanced training in human behavior and communication
1500+ hours of education in psychology, relational systems, human behavior, and coaching methodologies
Additional training in family systems and relationship-focused approaches
note: Please note: TranquilHaven Coaching provides coaching services only and does not provide psychotherapy, counseling, or mental health treatment in the United States.
